description: Start a job to create a video from a text description. First call chargen_quote_text_to_video, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Spends the quoted Gold; returns request_id to poll with chargen_get_job. Only the declared settings are supported. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio supported by the model, such as 16:9.

audio_id.description: Optional owned gallery reference audio UUID, where supported by the model.

duration_seconds.description: Video duration in seconds, where supported by the model.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

model.description: Enabled video model supporting text-to-video; chargen_list_media_models can help choose a model. This never changes the operation.

negative_prompt.description: Things to keep out of the result, as a short list. Only some models take one: chargen_list_media_models shows negative_prompt in that model's settings, and any other model refuses this argument.

prompt.description: What happens in the video, written for the chosen model. chargen_list_media_models with this mode says how to phrase it for each model (prompt_styles); nothing improves the wording on the way to the model.

prompt_expansion.description: Let the video model rewrite and lengthen the prompt before it renders, where the model offers it (chargen_list_media_models shows prompt_expansion in its settings). Off by default; leave it off for a prompt written in full.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_text_to_video. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

resolution.description: Resolution supported by the model, such as 720p.

video_id.description: Optional owned gallery reference video UUID, where supported by the model.

name: chargen_generate_text_to_video
title: Start text to video
